metadata.description: Validation test for the GPS Rescue fly-away check (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T14): the rescue switch at 12.5 s; from FLY_HOME a 25 m/s wind from the west carries the quad away faster than it can fly. After 30 s without progress the magnetometer is force-disabled and the count restarts; 30 s later the rescue fails with FLYAWAY, does nothing for 20 s, then aborts and disarms.
